name: SetConsensusParam
description: A registry node votes a value for a governable parameter (2/3 of the registry must agree).

params.name: node_privkey
params.help: the signing key (64 hex). Named node_privkey: ZBC_KEY does not apply, pass it explicitly

params.name: value
params.help: the value voted for, raw units

notes: No zbc-cli subcommand; the node's own key signs.
